boundary_rationale: Onset: Ezek.44.1 opens with a returning-transport verb that reopens the vision frame after the utterance close and double samekh at Ezek.43.27. Both sides of the seam are text-signalled: the vision's own close-device on one side, a fresh address opening a distinct instructional mode on the other.

boundary_rationale: Onset: the messenger formula at oshb:Ezek.45.18, following the samekh recorded after Ezek.45.17, opens this row; the law paragraph before it (45.9-17) already closed at that samekh, and the addressee and topic (the cultic calendar under the temple-law section) shift to the festival-calendar instruction beginning here. The unit that follows is the single festival-calendar paragraph running 45.18-25: New Year sanctuary cleansing (18-20, itself containing the non-dateline calendar date at 45.20), Passover (21-24, containing the non-dateline calendar date at 45.21), and the seventh-month feast (25, containing the non-dateline calendar date at 45.25). Close: the samekh recorded after Ezek.45.25 closes both the calendar-law paragraph and the chapter.
